security_concerns: _extract_year_filter_values expands biz_year between ranges with years.update(range(start, end + 1)) before bounding the span, so an untrusted candidate can submit an extremely large range and cause validator CPU/memory exhaustion instead of failing closed.
logic_errors: biz_year filters using >= or <= are treated as exact single years rather than bounded ranges; for example biz_year >= 2023 can validate without explicit 2023-2026 buckets and may let a later renderer read years outside the allowed 2023-2026 boundary.

The unsupported_tonnage reject rule is only checked for catalog integrity, not enforced as a blocking rule; a sql_direct plan can include business_rules=["unsupported_tonnage"] with requested_unit="MW" and still validate, allowing the tonnage-to-MW substitution the validator is intended to prevent.
suggestions: Keep the first-round fixes: all biz_year filters are now iterated and polluted catalog table/domain checks are present.
Add regression tests for biz_year >=/<= handling, bounded between expansion, unsupported_tonnage/action=reject enforcement, and schema_version mismatch rejection.
summary: First-round blockers appear fixed, but review fails because remaining fail-closed gaps can allow unsafe time-scope plans and unsupported tonnage plans to validate.
